headword: {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}

definitions.explanation: the practice of visiting potential customers or businesses without prior appointment to sell products or services

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}をする。
{新人|しんじん}は{飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}から{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: New employees start with cold calling.

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}は{断|ことわ}られることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: With cold calling, you get rejected a lot.

notes:
JAPANESE BUSINESS CULTURE:
{飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう} is a traditional sales method still used in Japan, especially for new salespeople to build experience.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {訪問販売|ほうもんはんばい} - door-to-door sales
- アポなし{営業|えいぎょう} - sales without appointment
- {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう} - cold calling (no appointment)
- {ルート営業|えいぎょう} - route sales (regular clients)
- テレアポ - telephone appointment

CHALLENGES:
- High rejection rate
- Requires mental resilience
- Increasingly replaced by digital marketing

RELATED WORDS:
- {門前払|もんぜんばら}い - being turned away at the door
- {名刺|めいし}を{渡|わた}す - hand out business cards
